retrievalProfile.description: A vibrant, tactile 3D composition featuring multiple fuzzy, felt-textured hands performing rock gestures against a dark, digital equalizer backdrop.

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast 3D scene where five distinctively colored, fuzzy-textured hands rise from the bottom edge in 'rock on' gestures. The hands are adorned with various stacked wristbands (glitter, neon, studded) and set against a black background featuring a subtle, dark-grey digital audio equalizer grid.
coreVisualRelationships: Tactile felt texture vs. digital neon lighting
Vertical upward movement of hands vs. horizontal equalizer grid
Saturated character colors vs. deep black negative space
coreInvariants: Fuzzy/felt surface material on all hands
Rock horns (index and pinky extended) hand gesture
Stacked decorative wristbands on each wrist

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Five hands of varying heights arranged horizontally across the lower two-thirds of the frame, with the central hand being the largest and most prominent.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large teal hand in the center, acting as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central hand, move outward to the flanking colorful hands, then upward to the display typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Solid black upper third and gaps between hands to emphasize the silhouette and texture.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black (background) providing high contrast for the subjects.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Teal, Magenta, and Pink (hand colors) creating a vibrant, playful palette.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Neon yellow, glitter silver, and rainbow patterns in the wristbands.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the subjects against a zero-value background to make the textures 'pop'.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain high contrast between subject and background

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, stylized sans-serif with dynamic flourishes
letterConstructionRules: Top tier: Thick, rounded forms with a glittery silver texture and a 'swoosh' extending from the first letter.
Middle tier: Sharp, aggressive, angular forms with red beveling and white faces, mimicking rock/metal aesthetics.
Bottom tier: Clean, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif for metadata.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial 'T' features a long, curved horizontal bar extending over the following letters.
Angular 'W' and 'R' with sharp, thorn-like serifs.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between soft/glittery decorative forms and sharp/aggressive rock-inspired forms.

preserve: Angular red-white contrast on middle tier

candidateDirections.reason: To match the tactile, toy-like quality of the hands.
For the middle tier to convey the 'tour' and 'rock' theme.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 3D render of five fuzzy, felt-textured hands in various colors (teal, magenta, pink, blue, purple) performing rock horn gestures. The hands should have stacked colorful and textured wristbands. The background is solid black with a subtle dark grey digital equalizer grid. Leave the top third of the image empty for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three levels of text: a top glittery silver decorative title with a swoosh, a middle white-and-red beveled angular rock-style title, and a bottom small white sans-serif metadata line.

verificationChecks: Is the felt texture visible on the hands?
Are there exactly five hands performing the rock gesture?
Is the equalizer grid present but subtle?
Does the typography follow the three-tier hierarchy?

mustAchieve: High-quality 3D subsurface scattering on the felt

postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic fiber detail on the hands
Ensure the 'rock horns' gesture is anatomically consistent across all hands
Verify the glitter texture on the top text tier is sparkling
Confirm the background equalizer is aligned to a grid
recipe.reuseFormula: Tactile 3D character elements + High-contrast black background + Multi-textured display typography = Playful Entertainment Key Art.
